item.description: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. said stabilizing South Korea’s currency would be a more effective way to curb inflation than raising interest rates, arguing that price pressures stem more from rising import costs than from strong domestic demand.
item.dc:creator: AKTUAL MEDIA

item.title: Review: MSCI Says No Change in Indonesia Market Consultation Process
item.description: US index compiler MSCI Inc. said Tuesday that it hadn’t changed its process for considering a downgrade of Indonesia’s stock-market status, a day after Bloomberg reported news of a meeting between the company’s chief executive and President Prabowo Subianto.
item.dc:creator: AKTUAL MEDIA

item.title: Review: As Tides Near Record Levels in California, a Storm Threatens to Make Things Worse
item.description: High tides reaching two or more feet above normal may cause flooding this week, forecasters warned.

item.title: Review: Copper Resumes Decline as Investors Look Beyond Drama at Nvidia
item.description: Copper resumed a decline after a spike driven by Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia Corp., with investors still cautious about demand.
